x-http.notes: Feature 027: no client_name parameter (unchanged) - this tool derives its client from the fetched original document (client.get_invoice(original_invoice_id)). If original.client.id is present, the new document's client object is {"self": false, "id": "<that same id>"} (REQ-INV-012) instead of today's {"self": false, "name": original.client.name}, which silently drops the id. If original.client.id is ABSENT (a pre-Feature-027 bare-name original), no document is created at all - a friendly refusal is returned instead (REQ-INV-013); this is a deliberate limitation, not a fallback to bare-name behavior.

original_invoice_id.description: Morning document id of the invoice being credited. Its client sub-object must have a real id or this tool refuses (REQ-INV-013).

amount.description: Optional override - defaults to the original's full total.
